KpiVisibility.description:
How a live KPI competes for the home page (visibility score, README.md).

The measure is the mean of the top 3 stations of the chosen place: the
median value of the display `driver` (`value`) or the probability
(`probability`, 0..1). Impact = (measure - floor) / (strong - floor),
clamped to 0..1; `strong` below `floor` means lower is stronger (e.g. a
colder wind chill). Below `floor` the tile is hidden from the home page.

floor.description: Below it (top-3 mean) the tile is not significant.
floor.title: Floor

strong.description: At or beyond it the impact is full (1).
strong.title: Strong

measure.description: value (needs a `value` display) or probability; default from the display.
measure.title: Measure

alert.description: Measure at or beyond which the tile is an alert: shown right after the pinned tiles (and, for the `early_alerts` filters of layout.yaml, tomorrow from noon).
alert.title: Alert

slots.description: `floor` and `strong` for the time slots, when they differ from the day's.
